The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 251.0. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-4989 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.96 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,908.26.
